metadata.description: Metis Foundry plugins for Claude Code: Metis Check settles the citations in an answer at the registries that issue them.

plugins.name: metis-check
plugins.description: The check every cited AI answer needs before you rely on it: each DOI, PubMed id, arXiv id, ORCID, ROR, ISBN, LEI, ISIN, CUSIP, SEC CIK, EIN, NPI, UK company number or domain is asked at the registry that issues it. One of four states per identifier, a signed report anyone can recheck. Free for 5 checks a month.
